name: UK energy price cap
summary: Energy cap £1,723; January forecasts range from +16% to +27%
state: The Ofgem cap for October–December is £1,723 a year. Cornwall Insight's latest forecast (14 Oct) puts January at £1,999, up 16%, while Uswitch's average of supplier forecasts (30 Oct) points to about +27%. Alert is held under hysteresis until Ofgem announces the January cap by 25 Nov; European gas fell about 9% on 2 Nov.
for_you: Bills are likely to rise in January; Ofgem and Citizens Advice list support schemes for households struggling with energy costs.
why: The Ofgem cap sets bills for most UK households — a direct cost-of-living signal.
drivers: Wholesale gas and power prices, network costs, policy levies.

rubric.normal: Typical dual-fuel cap < £1,700/yr and next forecast change < +5%.
